rationale: The AMENDMENT-1 plan is implementation-ready and soundly enforces the repository trust model through a layered, fail-closed architecture. The two-phase governance pivot correctly sequences activation. The reliance on bounded implementation spikes for E6 evaluator form and PD-001 completeness is well-defined, accompanied by fail-closed interim detection mechanisms, and ratified by the Eye directives; they represent implementation scheduling rather than architectural defects. The plan introduces no contradictions, explicitly handles edge cases such as x32 syscalls and io_uring, and meticulously manages cryptographic boundaries. Approved as-is.
